notes.notes:
Hey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372911/8c95dbccffe69793db82d6ae4aff06998a15d866.png

notes.notes:
Hello Humans!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372911/e836856d69f2209c1560225e1da67be8b09b6310.png

Humorous 2D point-and-click adventure Mad Cat's World about cat and vegan, ready for release! YOO-HOO! 
The release of Episode 1 will take place on April 01, 2020 at STEAM.
This is our first project, we hope you like it! =)

A DEMO version of the game is already available on STEAM (~15 minutes game time).
